title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：oil　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 oil 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the researcher ① poured the oil that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the pouring was the whole of the term. The ② oil, meaning the liquid itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; oil, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sample of oil in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ oil at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Oil, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the oil was the whole of the matter, meaning the wealth and not the liquid. The ⑥ oil, meaning the wealth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; oil, he said, is either something you pour or the only word that means both liquid and a wealth. He said the wealth is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ oil had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ oil of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; oil, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ oil I remember is the oil noted in the paper, which closed in 1993 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. ⑩ Oil, my mother said in 1995, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all oil, she said, is a wealth that has agreed to look like liquid. She said the wealth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 油；石油（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 油；石油（指那滴油本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：pour the oil 倒这一滴油
D. n. 油；石油（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 油之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的油之事）
F. n. 油；石油（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一滴）
G. n. 油、财源（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 财源（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: poured the oil that no student in the lab would have noted
The oil, meaning the liquid itself and not the tube
Every sample of oil in that lab
the oil at the far bench
the oil was the whole of the matter
the oil had become a line in a paper
The oil of the whole thing

answers.why: pour the oil 意为“倒这一滴油”，1986 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一滴油做了一遍。
oil 意为“油；石油”，指那滴油本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
oil 意为“油；石油”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
oil 意为“油；石油”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
oil 意为“油、财源”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这滴财源就是那件事的全部。
oil 意为“财源”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那滴油，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
oil 意为“油；石油”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一滴，到 1991 年这一滴成了研究报告里的一行。
oil 意为“油之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的油之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
oil 意为“油；石油”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一滴，1993 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一滴。
oil 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，油是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的油。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年那位研究员倒了实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一滴油，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（pour the oil）
那滴油，指的是那滴油本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（oil）
那处实验室里每一份油旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（oil）
最远那张实验台那滴油，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（oil）
叔叔说这滴财源就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那滴油。（oil）
1995 年母亲说，油是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的油。（oil）

The oil at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
